changelog:
v4.2.5 — 4K playback fix, part 2

• Fixes more 4K movies that played audio over a black screen and then showed "won't play smoothly on your current connection" — even on 4K devices with a fast connection. Many 4K files over-declare their video level; the app now checks what your hardware can actually decode instead of trusting the file's claim.
• 4K fixes now stick through the player's internal audio-decoder switch (5.1 audio titles were losing the video fix mid-start).
• Includes everything from v4.2.4: 4K Dolby Vision hardware decode, crash fix, smoother 4K buffering, Continue Watching repair.

As before: 4K titles require a 4K-capable streaming device (Fire TV Stick 4K / 4K Max). Non-4K playback is unchanged.
